"Kal ko realize karne ki limit—aj ke doubts."
Greatness position me nahi—person me hoti.
"Abhi tumhare andar sab kuch hai jo chahiye."
Mehnat karo, luck milega.
Tumhara kaam itna loud bolta hai, words sunai nahi dete.
Fear ko future decide mat karne do.
Imagination wahi grow karti jo tum nurture karo.
Tumhe kuch rok nahi sakta, except tum khud.
"Socho, kar sakte ho ya nahi…"
"Success good judgment ka result hai."
Perfect nahi, progress pe focus karo.
Thoughts badloge, life badlegi.
